messages:
aisha_karim: Hi team — I was assigned temporary guardianship of a 7-year-old through the county on 2026-03-15. Child was born abroad and only has an ITIN right now. Can I add them to health + dependent care FSA? Also we use a local daycare that isn't US-licensed. What docs are needed and how does proration work?
people-ops: Congrats and thanks for the heads up, Aisha. Yes this qualifies as a QLE (foster/placement). You'll have 60 days from the placement date to enroll. We can accept ITIN temporarily — SSN can be provided later.
people-ops: Required docs (upload to the QLE form):
```
- County placement letter or court order (with placement date)
- Foster/guardian letter from placement agency
- Passport or birth record (translation + apostille if not in English)
- If SSN missing: ITIN or statement and note that SSN will be uploaded within 60 days
```
people-ops: For the daycare: dependent care FSA requires that the care provider be licensed or that you certify care provider details if informal. If the provider is based abroad we need proof of paid care and that it's a dependent care expense under IRS rules — we'll coordinate with benefits_admin for documentation.
benefits_admin: Quick clarifications: 1) Health/dental/vision effective date is placement date (3/15) once QLE accepted. 2) Payroll will prorate premiums back to that date; expect the premium adjustment on next paycheck. 3) If SSN isn't provided within 60 days we may have to retro-remove the dependent pending IRS rules, but we'll notify you before any change.
payroll_ops: Confirming: premiums prorated to placement date, refunds or additional deductions run in the same payroll cycle; if amount crosses a month boundary we may split across two pay periods. If you need payroll exceptions ping me.
aisha_karim: For the passport/birth doc — it's not apostilled yet. Is a certified translation + county placement letter enough for now?
people-ops: Yes — certified translation + the placement letter is sufficient to accept the QLE. Apostille preferable but not required to get you enrolled. Please mark in the upload that apostille is pending.
benefits_admin: About the dependent care FSA and foreign provider: please include receipts showing care dates, payment method, provider name + location. Also fill this short FSA exception form: https://benefits.example.com/fsa-foreign-provider (link). We'll review on a case-by-case basis.
benefits-bot: Reminder: you have 60 days from 2241234567 (placement) to submit QLE & docs. Missing SSN must be resolved within 60 days or coverage may be reversed.
sarah_mgr: @aisha_karim let me know if you need flex time to visit the county office or get docs together — we've got your back. :heart:
aisha_karim: Thank you all — filing the QLE form now and will upload certified translation and placement letter. I'll follow up if payroll shows anything odd. Appreciate the help! :pray:
